originalFinding.message: Ensure that resources like this JMSContext object are closed after use

reason: failing is only a Proxy alias of receiver; receiver is allocated and owned by enclosing try-with-resources. Proxy adds no JMS provider resource; do not independently close the borrowed receiver mid-Test.

reason: Standalone JUnit fixture uses exact JMSContext interface defining loader to implement that interface; not J2EE webapp/container or ambient context-loader discovery.
